title: syrmatium ornithopus
intro: Syrmatium ornithopus, commonly known as Bird's Foot Trefoil, is a perennial legume native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its yellow flowers and trifoliate leaves. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. Syrmatium ornithopus is also known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
